Examples: They deduced the structure from the diffraction pattern. | Nothing could be deduced from a single reading.

Pattern: infer + N + from + N
Examples: Age was inferred from the growth rings. | They inferred the cause and could not prove it.

Pattern: postulate + N; postulate that + clause
Examples: He postulated a second mechanism in 1937. | They postulated an unseen companion star.

Pattern: refute + N; thường bị động
Examples: The claim was refuted by the original author. | They refuted the model with one field measurement.

Pattern: probe + N; danh từ a probe
Examples: They probed the sediment to nine metres. | The committee probed the funding arrangements.

Pattern: trace + N + to/back to + N
Examples: The contamination was traced to one tank. | They traced the lineage back nine generations.

Pattern: interdisciplinary + N (research, team)
Examples: The interdisciplinary team shared nothing but a corridor at first. | Interdisciplinary research is praised and rarely funded.

Pattern: speculative + N (claim, model)
Examples: The final section is openly speculative. | A speculative model is useful if it is labelled as one.

Pattern: provisional + N (finding, figure)
Examples: The figures are provisional until the audit. | A provisional finding was reported as settled fact.

Pattern: a robust + N (result, method)
Examples: The result is robust to every reasonable assumption. | A robust method survives careless hands.

Pattern: a flawed + N (study, design)
Examples: The study was flawed and widely quoted. | A flawed design cannot be rescued by statistics.

Pattern: a systematic + N (review, error)
Examples: A systematic review found nine usable trials. | Systematic error affects every reading the same way.

Definition: có đối chứng, có kiểm soát
Pattern: a controlled + N (trial, condition)
Examples: Controlled conditions are impossible in a field. | The controlled trial took four years to arrange.

Pattern: an unproven + N (claim, treatment)
Examples: The treatment remains unproven and widely sold. | An unproven claim was printed as a headline.

Pattern: a measurable + N (effect, change)
Examples: The effect is real and barely measurable. | There was no measurable change in nine years.

Definition: nhỏ đến mức bỏ qua được
Pattern: be negligible; a negligible + N
Examples: The difference is negligible at this scale. | The dose was negligible compared with background levels.

Pattern: a finite + N (resource, sample)
Examples: The sample is finite and the questions are not. | Finite funding decided which site was studied.

Pattern: a plausible + N (explanation, mechanism)
Examples: The explanation is plausible and unverified. | Two plausible mechanisms remain in contention.

Definition: đặt ra mục tiêu làm gì
Pattern: set out + to + V
Examples: They set out to disprove their own model. | She set out to count every nest on the island.

Pattern: zero in on + N; không tách được
Examples: They zeroed in on one stretch of the river. | The team zeroed in on a single enzyme.

Pattern: pin down + N hoặc pin + N + down; tách được
Examples: The date could not be pinned down closer than a century. | They pinned the source down to one outflow.

Pattern: puzzle out + N hoặc puzzle + N + out; tách được
Examples: They puzzled out the volume from three measurements. | She puzzled the sequence out over one winter.

Pattern: sift through + N; không tách được
Examples: They sifted through nine thousand records. | She sifted through the archive for two winters.

Definition: lập bản đồ, vạch ra chi tiết
Pattern: map out + N hoặc map + N + out; tách được
Examples: They mapped out the whole fault line. | The sequence was mapped out over four years.

Definition: chứng minh là đúng, xác nhận
Pattern: bear out + N hoặc bear + N + out; tách được
Examples: The field data bore out the prediction. | Nothing in the survey bears that claim out.

Pattern: the jury is still out + on + N
Examples: The jury is still out on the long-term effect. | On that mechanism the jury is still out.

Pattern: be + a shot in the dark
Examples: The first attempt was a shot in the dark. | It was a shot in the dark that happened to work.

Pattern: be + the acid test + of + N
Examples: Replication is the acid test of any finding. | The acid test comes when somebody else runs it.

Pattern: go hand in hand + with + N
Examples: Measurement and theory go hand in hand here. | Careful notes and good results go hand in hand.

Pattern: be + open to question
Examples: The interpretation is open to question. | Their sampling remains open to question.

Pattern: be/make + a quantum leap
Examples: The new detector was a quantum leap in sensitivity. | Sequencing made a quantum leap in a single decade.
